description: A plain Vite build with a lazy chunk, an index.html and a .vite/manifest.json, obfuscated afterwards by the `afterpack` CLI with no plugin. Proves the CLI renames every content-hashed chunk after its obfuscated bytes and rewrites the HTML, the manifest and the chunks that load it, and that `afterpack restore` undoes the renames byte for byte.

build.note: build.mjs runs `vite build`, then `afterpack dist` -- a plain `npm run build` already emits obfuscated, renamed output

interactions.description: Clicking the counter loads the renamed lazy chunk through its rewritten import and re-renders.
